rationale: All high-priority paper-path blockers have been fixed. The platform now has: (1) protected inverse ETF universe, (2) decoupled scanner from entry blocking, (3) persisted pending entries across restart, (4) trade update DLQ, (5) adaptive gap-fill, (6) session resilience, (7) comprehensive watchdog observability. Remaining risks are LOW severity and do not block unattended operation.
risks_acknowledged: DLQ file needs periodic manual review (check /tmp/intra_trade_update_dlq.jsonl)
Gaps > 1 hour on WebSocket not fully covered (extremely rare on Alpaca paper)
Watchdog alerts log to application log only — no external notification (Slack/email)
Pre-existing 28 test failures unrelated to trading path
what_would_make_READY: External alerting integration (Slack webhook for CRITICAL watchdog states)
One full live trading day with all hardening active showing normal operation
